weather.snow_note: WLD-069: the chance that a six-hour slot has snow, by season (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter): its own draw, in spells like rain, and before it (the owner, 2026-11-25: winter only, its own chance). [ASSUMPTION] 0.3.

note: The calendar, the weather odds and the tram timetable. real_seconds_per_minute sets how fast the clock runs: 10 means a game day lasts 4 real hours. People always walk at their true speed, so a faster clock makes them late (docs/specs/domains/WORLD_MAP.md, Q-21).
